item.title: YTKACE v21.40.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.40.5 | YTKACE 1.1.2 | YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_21.40.5
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.40.5 • Redesigned the download tab to look more like YouTube, with an All tab and your active downloads shown at the top • Smaller download popup that you can swipe away, and failed downloads stay so you can retry them • Playlist downloads now get the whole playlist, including private playlists and Liked videos • Liquid Glass tab bar is see-through while scrolling Shorts • Added Frosted Tab Bar option (Default, On, Off) • Added Normal Home Layout for the Home redesign some accounts get • Added Remove Horizontal Shelves • Added Hold to Copy Text for community posts and comments • Added Play Shorts Once • Added Two-Finger Tap to Pause • Added Extra Dim • Added Share at Current Time • Added Lock Screen Skip • Added Remove Suggestion Pill for Shorts • SponsorBlock skip popup now fades in and out
Fixed: • Shorts download button, Fullscreen and pinch to fullscreen on the new Shorts UI • Captions On picking the wrong language • App opening in Shorts when a different start tab is set • White or black bar behind the Liquid Glass tab bar • Share sheet position on iPad
YouTube 21.40.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_21.40.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.2_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

item.title: YTKACE v21.39.4
item.description:
YouTube 21.39.4 | YTKACE 1.1.1 | YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_21.39.4
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.39.4 • Liquid Glass on iOS 26 for the tab bar, top bar buttons, menus, sheets, player buttons and YTKACE popups • Liquid Glass settings page with a toggle for each part • Selected Tab Color for the tab text or the text and icon • Added HLS mode in Playback Fix • Added 5x speed in the speed menu • Improved native share sheet
Fixed: • Multiple scrubber dots on feed videos with a custom scrubber • Direct downloads using an outdated client
YouTube 21.39.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_21.39.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.1_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

item.title: YTKACE v21.38.3
item.description:
YouTube 21.38.3 | YTKACE 1.1.0 | YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_21.38.3
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.38.3 • Redesigned the YTKACE library player with a floating mini player, PiP and YouTube style controls • SponsorBlock now skips segments in downloaded videos • New Download Method option with Direct downloads • Modify YouTube's video zoom • Keep Shorts in Subscriptions • Option to disable PiP for Shorts • Speed menu button • Options to disable HDR, remove 1080p Premium and set a separate Shorts speed • Layout mode option • Choose the subtitle language for downloads
Fixed: • PiP not working for music videos • Gap left by hidden comment guidelines, topic chips and community posts • Download and queue buttons on older YouTube versions • Autoplay in queues • Improved Playback Fix and download retrying
Thanks to @Ganeron11 and @kes158 for contributions
YouTube 21.38.3 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_21.38.3.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

item.title: YTKACE v21.37.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.37.5 | YTKACE 1.0.0 | YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.37.5 • Queue videos without Premium — play next, play last, reorder, shuffle, loop and clear • Playlist downloads — grab every video or pick the ones you want • YouTube's Download button can now open the YTKACE menu • Choose where the download button lives: player overlay, YouTube's button, or both • Save downloads to the share sheet, with separate video and audio destinations • Hide the products shelf • iOS 15 support for the tweak packages
Fixed: • 2K and 4K missing from the download quality list • Shorts Save button not removed unless YouTube was in English • Community posts breaking with Block Premium Prompts on • Action bar disappearing while scrolling the feed • Settings unreachable if both the YTKACE and Library tabs were removed • YTKACE settings opening another tweak's settings when both were installed
YouTube 21.37.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_21.37.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.0.0_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
